modifications: Shared only Qwen trunk loading, serialization, typed answer formatting, status, and route receipts across candidate scorers
Kept Decision 2.0 candidate-head math, pplx readout math, and JEV verbalizer math in separate family modules
Restricted Decision 2.0 to the full Lux 9B package and rejected unmerged LoRA and calibrated package variants
Restricted pplx-decider to its bare 27B backbone plus exact 255-row readout and trained code-token mapping
Restricted JEV to the prepared text-only 9B MLX layout with embedded calibration metadata
Rejected media, generation, MTP tensors, unsupported geometries, and malformed package paths before execution
Preserved Hugging Face snapshot filenames while validating symlink targets inside the repository blob store
Applied mlx2 tokenizer-integrity repair after local tokenizer loading; did not use Transformers' incompatible Mistral-regex rewrite
Preserved Decision 2.0 request order for choice and fully-described noul options to match the reference causal prompt
Validated the official BF16 pplx readout with MLX because the safetensors NumPy backend cannot materialize BF16
Normalized family outputs to a shared mlx2 response: noul naming, maximum-probability confidence, legends, and metadata differ from upstream wire formats
Kept explicit truncate=true support as an mlx2 service extension and documented that smoke evidence does not establish reference parity
Added finite JSON/probability validation, recursive media refusal, Unicode and nesting checks, absolute HTTP deadlines, and pre-forward validation of every question
Bound Hub-cache route receipts to detected 40-hex revisions and declared Hub blob filename identities without claiming payload re-hashing; labelled non-Hub fingerprints as layout metadata
Bound each request to at most 64 questions and candidate aggregate prompts to eight times the per-question context
Capped rendered state at 1 MiB, choices at 255, and score levels at 10; refused reserved model-control tokens and truncation that would erase the entire nonempty state
Validated JEV verbalizers against vocabulary size and moved tokenizer-dependent validation before weight materialization
Kept all routes outside the causal-LM registry, scheduler, generation lifecycle, and APCv2
Added revision-bound production qualification receipts that fail startup closed on source, producer, runtime, artifact, or serving-setting drift
Added bounded Prometheus request, refusal, failure, token, latency, load, inflight, CPU, memory, route, and qualification telemetry
